entries.text: Hi, it's Sarah from HeliumDeploy. Thanks for taking a few minutes with me: your code, 15% off the Bitaxe Supra Hex 703 (4.2TH/s) on orders of $150+, shows up on screen as soon as we finish. I see you were looking at the Bugatti Gatsby Carry-On. What caught your eye?
It's for a two week trip to Portugal with my wife in November. We fly Air Transat.
A two-week trip to Portugal in November sounds lovely. Air Transat is good to know, since carry-on rules matter. What matters most to you in choosing a carry-on?
Mostly, it has to fit the carry on size limit. And be light. I really hate heavy bags.
Light is key, got it. Nobody wants to haul a heavy bag through airports. Have you looked at any other stores or brands for a bag like this?
I looked at Samsonite on Amazon and something at Costco. But the Bugatti looks nicer.
Good to know the Bugatti's look wins for you. What's holding you back from buying it today, if anything?
Honestly, I just want to know the exact dimensions. And if shipping is fast enough before the trip,
Fair enough. The B. product page has the exact dimensions, and the store's shipping page has delivery times. I don't want to guess either one. How did you first find HeliumDeploy?
I saw an Instagram ad a few days ago. That's how I found you.
An Instagram ad, thanks. We mostly sell small home crypto miners too. If you ever looked at one, would noise or heat worry you?
No. I think that covers it. Thanks a lot. Bye.
Thank you so much for your time, and enjoy Portugal with your wife! Your code is coming up on your screen now. Goodbye!
